name: Content Refinement Loop
description: Refines text using identity context and prior memory. Run twice to see compounding — run 2 references run 1's self-evaluation to make different improvements.

steps.name: Search for prior refinements of similar content
Refine content using identity + prior memory

args.prompt:
You are a writing refinement system. Take rough text and make it better.

USER IDENTITY:
{{context.identity}}

TEXT TO REFINE:
{{context.text}}

PRIOR REFINEMENT MEMORY:
{{step_2}}

== RULES ==

1. Keep refined_text CONCISE — max 100 words plain text. NO markdown, NO code blocks, NO curly braces in the text. Use dashes for lists.
2. If prior memories exist (non-empty array above): read the self_evaluation and what_id_do_differently_next_time. EXPLICITLY quote what the prior run noted and make DIFFERENT improvements. Set prior_run_referenced: true.
3. If no prior memories (empty array): first pass. Focus on clarity and audience fit. Set prior_run_referenced: false.
4. Be brutally honest in self_evaluation.
5. ESCAPE all special characters in string values. No unescaped quotes or braces.

Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown fences, NOT an array). All 6 fields required:
{"refined_text": "plain text, max 100 words", "improvements_made": ["change 1", "change 2"], "self_evaluation": "what is still weak", "what_id_do_differently_next_time": "concrete next-pass strategy", "prior_run_referenced": false, "prior_run_improvements": null}

steps.name: Log refinement to memory for future runs
